title: The Italian lawmaking process: a unified and structured dataset
abstract: arXiv:2610.23741v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Italian legislative process is documented in detailed parliamentary records hosted in institutional websites. However, much of this information is available only as unstructured text, limiting its systematic reuse. We applied a controlled, systematic LLM-based extraction procedure, validated against manually annotated records, to convert these texts into ordered and dated events including, e.g., bill introduction, committee examination, plenary examination, and approval. The resulting dataset reconstructs the procedural histories of all 5346 Italian laws enacted between 1985 and 2026, spanning parliamentary terms IX to XIX, for overall 101413 events. Each event records the activity, date, and chamber, with additional procedural details where available. translated_title: 意大利立法程序：一个统一且结构化的数据集
translated_abstract: 意大利的立法过程记录在托管于官方网站的详细议会档案中。然而，这些信息大部分仅以非结构化文本形式存在，限制了其系统化的再利用。我们采用了一种经过控制的、基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统性提取流程，并通过人工标注记录进行验证，将这些文本转换为有序且标注日期的事件，例如法案提出、委员会审议、全体会议审议和批准等。由此生成的数据集重建了1985年至2026年间颁布的全部5346部意大利法律的程序历史，涵盖第九届至第十九届议会任期，共计101413个事件。每个事件都记录了活动内容、日期和议院，并在可用的情况下包含额外的程序细节。该数据集为计算法学与立法研究这两个新兴领域提供了支持，并有望与面向流程的数据科学方法相结合，用于研究程序动态。
tldr: 本文通过经验证的基于大语言模型的提取流程，将非结构化的意大利议会档案转换为覆盖1985至2026年间5346部法律、共101413个事件的统一结构化立法程序数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a validated LLM-based extraction pipeline that converts unstructured Italian parliamentary records into a unified structured dataset of 101,413 legislative events covering all 5,346 laws enacted between 1985 and 2026.
